nodes.label: config.json
nodes.rationale: Holds all deployment-specific values (server_port, api_domains, MariaDB credentials); credentials are never hardcoded.

nodes.label: DB Connection (Peewee init)
nodes.rationale: If no mariadb_host is configured, db is None and check_db_connection() returns False, so the server starts without a database.

nodes.label: memex-redux MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Personal data gateway exposing personal and home automation data to Claude Code via MCP.

nodes.label: Tool Plugins (tools/)
nodes.rationale: One file per data domain; gitignored so user plugins stay local.

nodes.label: models.example.py Template
nodes.rationale: Shows common Peewee patterns: simple tables, tables without a primary key, composite primary keys.

nodes.label: Vannevar Bush Memex (1945 Essay)
nodes.rationale: Project name is a homage to Bush's envisioned device for storing and linking all of a person's knowledge and experience.

nodes.label: Setup Workflow
nodes.rationale: Clone and uv sync, copy config.example.json, optionally copy models.example.py, add tool plugins, run via uvicorn or Docker.

nodes.label: Database Access Pattern (Peewee to MariaDB)
nodes.rationale: Multi-table joins live inside the tool function, invisible to Claude.

nodes.label: Generic Extensible MCP Server Skeleton
nodes.rationale: Core infrastructure is data-source agnostic; all data sources are added as tool plugins so the core never changes per deployment.

nodes.label: HTTP Access Pattern (requests to external API)
nodes.norm_label: http access pattern (requests to external api)

nodes.label: Read-only Tools Constraint
nodes.rationale: No writes to the database or external APIs.

nodes.label: Read-only MariaDB Account
nodes.rationale: Dedicated account with SELECT only, enforcing read-only access at the database level.

nodes.label: Tool Registry Auto-discovery
nodes.rationale: core/tool_registry.py imports every *.py directly in tools/ at startup, so no registration step is needed; tools/samples/ is deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: Tools as Natural Questions
nodes.rationale: Tools represent natural questions, not database tables; the description is what Claude reads to pick a tool, so it is written as a human question.

nodes.label: Gitignored User Files
nodes.rationale: config.json, models.py and tools/*.py are gitignored because they contain credentials, schema and personal plugins.

nodes.label: Call Log Ring Buffer
nodes.rationale: In-memory buffer of the last 50 tool calls.

nodes.label: FastMCP (mcp SDK)
nodes.rationale: Official Anthropic Python MCP SDK, instantiated with stateless_http=True and mounted onto FastAPI at /mcp.

nodes.label: Status Web UI
nodes.rationale: Served at / from templates/status.html; auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

nodes.label: claude mcp add Client Connection
nodes.rationale: --scope user makes the server available across all Claude Code projects; .mcp.json is the per-project alternative.

nodes.label: Frontend Conventions (Bootstrap 5 + Vanilla JS)
nodes.rationale: No frameworks or build step; all JS in static/app.js and all CSS in static/app.css, no inline script or style tags.

nodes.label: Streamable HTTP Transport
nodes.rationale: Chosen over SSE because SSE transport was deprecated as of 2025-03-26.

nodes.label: Uvicorn-managed Logging
nodes.rationale: All logging configured via uvicorn_log_config.ini, no separate Python logging config; logs lifecycle, tool invocations, HTTP connector calls and DB errors to stdout.
